details:
So I saw a couple posts that give this same general idea already, but I figured I'd give my two cents on it since I thought of the idea independently. I'm also not sure how realistically feasible this idea is, but I do think it's still worth some thought.

The idea is to have an extra status option, likely something akin to a "Yellow" status that bridges the gap between Green and Orange.

To put it simply, a Yellow status would allow people to see what world a player is in, but not the specific instance. It would also require an invite request to join.

The thought behind this for me is that I know that I, and likely many others, sometimes find it hard to request invites off of people who are on Orange. For me personally, the thought stems from the idea that if they don't want to hang out that my request would be bothering them in some way.

Having a status that shows the world a player is in but not the instance would give a better idea of whether or not that person is more open to an invite request.

It would still leave a reason for both Green and Orange to exist, as Green would still be beneficial if someone is in a public lobby, and Orange can still be used if someone wants a little more privacy without going on Red.

It may not necessarily be perfect, as if a player with Yellow status is in a public lobby, or in a friends+ with someone else, then people may still be able to join another way, but I think the implication would be that the Yellow player is accepting of that fact. If they weren't, they'd just go on Orange.
title: Add a "Yellow" status, or something similar.
